record_title: Exact three-consecutive-derivative threshold for bounded-inner-diameter domains
provenance: Derivative-set refinement of the finite-inner-diameter Rubel theory developed in Cameron MacMahon, arXiv:2609.20607.
limitations: The theorem classifies the universal guarantee over simply connected finite-inner-diameter domains, not every fixed domain. It does not optimize cusp regularity or quantitative divergence rates. The 1984 Rubel paper was not independently inspected and remains a residual originality risk; the direct source is also very recent. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
